notes.title: New Mode: Riley Rush
notes.notes:
I got to thinking what Riley would be like in a more arcade-like setup, given his unique attributes.
The new Riley Rush mode is the result, accessible from the starting area.
It’s pretty wild.
Personal best thus far: 5575
